name: Stolen-Key Validation via Credential Scanner
description: When a secret access key leaks in a Git repo or a paste site, scanners such as TruffleHog immediately try it against AWS to see if it still works. That check usually shows up as GetCallerIdentity — a harmless-looking 'who am I?' call — with a distinctive tool name in the user agent. The person running the scanner may be a researcher, or it may be the attacker confirming they have a live key before they do anything louder. Either way, the account should treat a scanner user agent as 'this key is in the wild' and rotate it.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
